comments.author: @LifewaysTravel
comments.text: Unpopular opinion: Maui may be one of the best places in America to visit, but not necessarily one of the best places to live. Agree or disagree?

replies.author: @MagaMama3432
replies.text: Disagree. I’ve lived on Maui 26 years and won’t live anywhere else. If you respect the culture, you’ll be respected by the locals and accepted. If you don’t, they won’t.  Tourism is the most important part of the economy, but we don’t enjoy the tourists, especially when they’re disrespectful. This ain’t the mainland!
